meta.description: Duba maganinka, ji yadda ake shan sa a harshenka, kuma ka sami tunatarwa idan lokaci ya yi.

header.readAloudUnavailable: Karantawa da murya ba ya aiki a wannan burauza tukuna.
header.voiceMissing: Wannan na'ura ba ta da muryar {language} tukuna. Karanta katin, ko ka tambayi mai harhaɗa maganinka.

landing.lead: Ɗauki hoton lambar magani ka ji ta a Igbo, Yoruba, Hausa, Pidgin ko Turanci. Samu tunatarwa a kowace waya. Likitan maganinka yana gani lokacin da kake buƙatar taimako.
landing.previewLabel: Nunin kai tsaye · Magani ɗaya, harsuna biyar
landing.previewVoiceMissing: Babu muryar {language} a wannan na'ura tukuna. Karanta jimlar a maimakon haka.
landing.previewRingLabel: An sha {taken} daga cikin {total} na maganin yau
landing.howTitle: Daga kantin magani zuwa adadin da ya dace a gida
landing.howIntro: Matakai huɗu, ba a buƙatar karatu. Kowane mataki yana aiki ba tare da intanet ba kuma yana komawa SMS.
landing.step1Body: Nuna kyamara ga lamba ko takardar magani. AI tana karanta magani, adadi da lambar NAFDAC.
landing.step2Body: Ana faɗar umarni a harshenka, da kalmomi masu sauƙi.
landing.step3Body: Tunatarwa ta manhaja, SMS ko kiran murya. Ana sanar da masu kulawa idan an rasa adadi.
landing.step4Body: Kalmomin haɗari kamar “ciwon ƙirji” suna sanar da likitan maganinka kuma suna nuna asibiti mafi kusa.
landing.viewsIntro: Kowane asibiti yana da nasa wurin da aka tabbatar. Ana duba ma'aikata da marasa lafiya da bayanan asibitin.
landing.viewsPatientsSees: Adadin yau, ci gaba, maganin da ya rage
landing.viewsPatientsDoes: Ɗauki hoto, saurara, tambaya da murya, duba
landing.viewsStaffSees: Haɗarin bin magani, faɗakarwa, illolin magani
landing.viewsStaffDoes: Amsa tambayoyi, wallafa shawarar da aka tabbatar
landing.viewsStaffVerified: ID na ma'aikaci + MDCN / PCN / NMCN
landing.viewsHospitalsSees: Ma'aikata, marasa lafiya, tabbatarwa, canja wuri
landing.viewsHospitalsDoes: Ɗora jerin sunaye, amince da ma'aikata
landing.phoneTitle: Babu smartphone? Babu data? Har yanzu an rufe ka.
landing.phoneBody: Tunatarwa tana zuwa ta SMS ko kiran murya. Amsa 1 idan ka sha. Manhajar kuma tana aiki ba tare da intanet ba kuma tana daidaitawa daga baya.
landing.phoneSms: 08:00 Mama Nkechi, sha Lisinopril 10mg yanzu. Amsa 1 idan ka sha, 2 idan ba ka sha ba.
landing.phoneFigure: Waya mai sauƙi tana nuna tunatarwar SMS da amsar “1”.
landing.safeIntro: AI tana bayyanawa kuma tana tunatarwa. Yanke shawara yana hannun ƙwararru masu lasisi.
landing.safe1Body: Babu rubuta magani, babu canza adadi. Tambayoyin da ba su bayyana ba suna zuwa ga likitan maganinka.
landing.safe2Body: Ana kama kalmomin gaggawa kafin kowace AI ta yi aiki.
landing.safe3Body: Izini da farko, bayanan da aka ɓoye, sauke ko goge bayananka.
landing.safe4Body: Saƙonnin dandalin tattaunawa daga ƙwararrun MDCN, PCN da NMCN masu lasisi kawai.
landing.ctaTitle: Ga yadda yake aiki cikin ƙasa da minti ɗaya.
landing.ctaBody: Zaɓi rawa: mara lafiya, likitan magani ko mai kula da asibiti.
landing.previewAudioSoon: Muryar wannan harshe tana zuwa. Karanta jimlar a yanzu.
